title: The Sagrada Família tour was special
text: We had a wonderful, informative time.  Jorge was an excellent guide.  He provided a very thorough and useful tour of Sagrada Família.  We had several people in our group that only speak English and Jorge carried out the entire tour in English, without any problems.  We would highly recommend this tour, especially with Jorge.
author: Christopher_R

title: Jorge is the best!
text: Jorge was an amazing guide! He was so knowledgeable, kind and funny! He was on time, professional and answered all of our questions. He is a certified guide, who has 11 years experience. We loved the tour and cannot say enough about Jorge!
author: christinecX4546SC

title: Take the golden hour -...
text: Take the golden hour - it’s worth it. And take it with Albert, if you want to know Sagrada Família!! His in-depth knowledge of the holy book and the link to Antoni Gaudi and this important architectural masterpiece is deeply satisfying
author: Wolfgang_S

title: Alberto is awesome
text: Our guide, Alberto, was amazing. His knowledge the basilica is unsurpassed. Well worth it! I would highly recommend this tour.
author: Ivette_H

title: A Great, Customized Tour
text: The custom nature of our tour was second to none. Raul was very knowledgeable and patient with our slow walking.  Most importantly, he listened to us and then customized the tour in a way that made it very meaningful, given our Christian backgrounds.
author: Joseph_S

title: Jesus was our guide for...
text: Jesus was our guide for Sagradad Familia Golden hour, he was very knowledgeable, spoke great English and ensured that we were at all the correct spots to capture golden hour. Highly recommend this tour and this exceptional guide.
author: All_B

title: Jana is an excellent...
text: Jana is an excellent guide and made the tour was very informative and interesting. I highly recommend adding this tour to your trip to Barcelona.
author: sue10105

title: Don't miss this experience!

title: Guide and spectacular light.
text: Our guide Anna was terrific. We took a tour with Viking the same morning and Anna was far superior. She gave us unique insight and kept the group moving together. The golden hour and light were spectacular.

text: Excellent guide, excellent service. Very grateful.
